title: SAEBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Sparse Autoencodersin Language Model Interpretability
one_line: SAEBench评估SAE系统，揭示传统指标缺陷与Matryoshka优势

takeaways: 传统稀疏-保真度指标不可靠
